Title: Spring- Loaded Car — Part 2
Content: The spring key used to wind the spring inside the car is turned `10` times, and the car is placed at the bottom of a long ramp.

The car moves up the ramp. `text(Two)` points, `text(X)` and `text(Y)`, are indicated on the ramp. Careful data collection and calculation presented in Table `2` shows the amount of energy the car has at Point `text(X)`.

After the car passes Point `text(Y)`, it slows and stops `2` `text(meters)` from the starting position. Graph `1` shows the approximate speed of the car as it climbs the ramp and before it begins to roll backward because of gravity.
